leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the useState hook to manage a boolean state variable representing a loading or pending status.
Implement the useState hook to manage an array state variable for a list of items.
Construct an asynchronous handler function to simulate a network request with a delay.
Utilize the setState function to update the array state optimistically before the asynchronous request completes.
Execute conditional logic to handle successful completion of the asynchronous request and update the array state with the confirmed data.
Control error handling by using a try-catch block to revert the optimistic update if the request fails.
Invoke the asynchronous handler function from an event handler, such as a button click.
Define a TypeScript interface to type the structure of items in the array state.
Modify the UI to conditionally render a loading indicator based on the boolean pending state.
Return JSX that maps over the array state to display each item and includes the button to trigger the optimistic update.
